svg.title: Advection Without Locality
svg.desc: Curl 14.7, field frequency 0.073, and 28-pixel steps all exceed the normal controls. The integration step crosses multiple changing directions, so five hundred trajectories become a dense map of finite-step discontinuities rather than smooth physical streamlines. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → mirrored flow discontinuities, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
